The day that comes after Monday is Tuesday.

The setting is the interior corridors of an ancient castle located in the Scottish Highlands. The specific time is not explicitly stated, but the description of a "dramatic sky" and "ever-changing dance of clouds and light" suggests it is daytime. The place is characterized by cool, echoic stone corridors inside the castle, with a view of the endless green hills, purple heather, and a deep, still Loch outside, evoking the atmosphere of medieval Scotland.
